'''Sprax''' was a [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]], a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of Black Sun, and operator of various illegal trade groups.

==Biography==
Sprax began his career as an heir and executive within the Celanon-based [[Jatayus Trading Consortium]], but left the organization before rising to its upper-leadership, choosing instead to take a secret position in Black Sun. Under the aegis of the cartel, he served as an apprentice to a [[Unidentified Brentaal merchant house guildmaster|guildmaster]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], where he used his knowledge in shipping and finance to propote Black Sun's interests. When his apprenticeship was completed, he was hired as a division supervisor with [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]], overseeing [[freighter/Legends|freighter]] operations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. He retired, wealthy and still youthful and fled to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> 

But this was a pretense; in reality he gained the rank of Vigo in Black Sun. Sprax' criminal networks profited from his previous experience, as they focused on trade crimes; of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], pirates, [[Black market/Legends|black market]], and manufacturing officials. Bribed executives or [[spaceport/Legends|starport]] officials, helped to reroute the stolen, [[Shipjacker/Legends|shipjacked]] or misrouted goods, found their buyers. Some of them were coerced to cooperate, and most of them were unaware that Black Sun was behind these operations. XTS ensured that the operations stretched across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Sprax also took some profit from [[spice/Legends|spice]] and [[slavery/Legends|slave trade]], trying not to meddle with other Vigos's businesses.<ref name="sb" />

One of the times he was urgently summoned to [[Xizor's Palace]], the Underlord mentioned to him his interest in [[RenTrans]] company, who were unwilling to be bought. He ordered Sprax to summon bring his underling [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] without traceable connections to their business affairs. Sprax expressed some curiosity, and as Xizor trusted him, he explained that 
a certain ship, ''[[Doriella's Mystress]]'', was docked on [[docking pad RT209]], and his operatives were supposed to tamper with its control and drive system, and add [[detonite/Legends|detonite]] charges to its [[Power core/Legends|power core]] to create an "accident". Xizor hoped that either the [[Rendar family]] would reconsider his offer, or would be disgraced by the Emperor, and its business awarded to himself.<ref name="merger">{{WEGCite|story=The Business Merger|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> Indeed, as a result, the ship was destroyed, in the process killing [[Stanton Rendar]], its pilotm and destroying [[Emperor Palpatine's private museum]].<ref name="sb" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Sprax had some [[agent/Legends|agents]] within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was informed about their activities; he made a considerable fortune in trading weapons, medical supplies, and spare parts (his [[Sublieutenant/Legends|Sublieutenant]] stole and salvaged starships and resold their parts), often under Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] orders, favoring the Rebellion over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when possible.<ref name="sb" /> Sprax's center of operations was located along the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

By c. [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he'd grown out of his species' short-lived youth, retaining the rank despite its notoriously low survival rate. In that time, he became one of the foremost smuggler patrons and fences in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. In addition to his Black Sun rival, Vigo [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]], Sprax' main competition along the Sisar Run consisted of several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] Clans and the [[Antar Band]], the latter led by [[Ujin Voli]].

Asked by [[Guri]] on the whereabouts of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Sprax used his contacts to the Alliance and learned that the [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], a Rebel group to which Skywalker was closely affiliated, was heading to  [[Kile]] in the [[Zhar system]]; he also learned, and informed Guri, that their [[Chief Technician]], [[Viera Cheran]] was dissatisfied with her position.<ref name="sb" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> Xizor summoned all his Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his Palace]], and they all complied; Sprax had to leave some shipping operations for him. They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by [[Howzmin]]. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culpit to the remaining eight of them. As for Sprax, he was thinking his businesses, and the positive report he had to give to Xizor; but he knew someone was a traitor but did not want to make scenarios, until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> At the conclusion of the meeting, Sprax witnessed as Xizor had Guri [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Green]] in front of the other Vigos, as a message to any Vigos who would try to sell information.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

After Xizor's death in the [[Battle over Coruscant]], the Black Sun was in the verge of an [[Black Sun civil war|internecine crime war]]. The Vigos assembled in a council where [[Vekker (Quarren)|Vekker]] was seen arguing loudly with Sprax.<ref name="SEE3">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 3|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 3]]</ref>

==Characteristics==
By 3 ABY, Sprax was an aging male by Nalroni standards, so he concealed his graying fur with dye to give it the golden-brown hue of his youth. He had adapted the style of speech and fashion typical of Brentaal merchants, and wore the long tunic and tailed jackets.<ref name="sb" />

He was notable for his intelligence and his loyalty; he knew better than betraying Xizor.<ref name="sb" />
